subject: EVALUATE directive
notes: GR1 (cite.py --check 7.3.13.4 OK): text-1/text-2 are not part of the directive line, and their non-directive text words are subject to COPY/REPLACE matching. Render() consumes only lines starting '>>' as directives; every other emitting line is accumulated into a block and Flush() runs CopyProcessor.ExpandCopiesOneLevel on it, and REPLACE acts downstream on the resultant text; omitted lines are blanked. Probe p2.cob: REPLACE ==FOOTAG== BY =="GR1-REPLACE-OK"== then text-1 'DISPLAY FOOTAG' and 'COPY cb1 REPLACING ==ZZTAG== BY =="GR1-COPY-OK"==' inside a taken >>WHEN -> printed GR1-REPLACE-OK, GR1-COPY-OK; a REPLACE statement inside the omitted WHEN OTHER text did not act (its pseudo-text word stayed undefined, COBOL1639), and a nested >>IF inside text-1 was processed as a directive, not as text words. Both halves verified. No spec-derived golden exercises COPY/REPLACE inside >>EVALUATE text.
